youtube_title: Craving Chocolate Every Night? What It Really Means | Body Fix #3 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #3. Chocolate craving EVERY night after dinner? The internet says your body 'needs' something.
Mostly B. Low sleep, stress and HABIT. The 'deficiency' idea has weak evidence.
Skipped meals, short sleep, same time every day: your brain asks for the same reward.
Fix: Proper meals with protein, full sleep, wait 10 MIN. Still want it? One small piece.
Red flags: Can't stop bingeing, or appetite and mood changed a lot? Talk to a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: Harvard Health / Mayo Clinic - food cravings
